default.title: Warm-up
default.prompt: Write a function is_even(n) that returns True when n is even and False otherwise.

Variables and types.title: Swap two values
Variables and types.prompt: Given a = 5 and b = 9, swap their values without using a third variable, then print a and b.
Variables and types.starter:
a = 5
b = 9
# swap a and b here

print(a, b)

Conditions and loops.prompt: Write a function count_vowels(text) that returns how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in text, ignoring case.

Lists and slicing.title: Middle of a list
Lists and slicing.prompt: Write a function middle(items) that returns a new list without the first and last elements. For [1, 2, 3, 4] it returns [2, 3].

Strings.title: Palindrome check
Strings.prompt: Write a function is_palindrome(word) that returns True if word reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case.

Functions.title: Largest of three
Functions.prompt: Write a function largest(a, b, c) that returns the largest of three numbers without using max().

Dictionaries and sets.title: Word count
Dictionaries and sets.prompt: Write a function word_count(sentence) that returns a dictionary mapping each word to how many times it appears.

Tuples and unpacking.title: Min and max together
Tuples and unpacking.prompt: Write a function min_max(numbers) that returns a tuple (smallest, largest) without using min() or max().

List comprehensions.title: Squares of evens
List comprehensions.prompt: Using one list comprehension, write a function even_squares(numbers) that returns the squares of the even numbers only.

Recursion.title: Factorial
Recursion.prompt: Write a recursive function factorial(n) that returns n! for n >= 0. Do not use a loop.

Classes and objects.title: A counter class
Classes and objects.prompt: Write a class Counter with a value that starts at 0, a method increment() that adds 1, and a method reset() that sets it back to 0.

Errors and exceptions.title: Safe division
Errors and exceptions.prompt: Write a function safe_divide(a, b) that returns a / b, or None when b is zero, using try and except.

Files and modules.title: Count lines
Files and modules.prompt: Write a function count_lines(path) that opens the file at path with a with statement and returns the number of lines in it.
